description: Source code for Asset Maintenance management in ERPNext, including class definition, task validation, assignment, and log updates.

classes.name: AssetMaintenance
classes.description: Represents an asset maintenance record with validation, update, and synchronization methods.

methods.name: assign_tasks
methods.description: Assigns maintenance tasks to team members and creates corresponding to-do items.

methods.name: calculate_next_due_date
methods.description: Calculates the next due date based on periodicity and date parameters.

methods.name: update_maintenance_log
methods.description: Creates or updates maintenance logs based on tasks.

methods.name: get_team_members
methods.description: Retrieves team members for a maintenance team.

methods.name: get_maintenance_log
methods.description: Fetches maintenance log summary for a specific asset.
